method_md:
- **Data:** Walmart M5, 3 Texas stores, FOODS category. Backtest Feb 29 – May 22, 2016 (3 folds × 28 days).
- **Forecasts:** one global LightGBM model (Tweedie loss) for expected daily demand, plus P50/P90 quantile models. Features are measured at each Monday forecast origin (no leakage).
- **Policy:** deliveries Monday (covers Mon–Wed) and Thursday (Thu–Sun). Order up to expected demand until the next delivery + z × σ × √days, where σ is the daily sales std over the 28 days before the origin.
- **Naive policy:** identical rule, but expected demand = 28-day moving average × days.
- **Simulation:** actual sales as demand, lost sales when the shelf is empty, leftovers carry over, no spoilage. Products with likely-unavailable days in the test period are excluded (true demand unknown).
- **Costs:** holding cost = inventory value × annual rate / 365; lost margin = lost sales value × margin.
